direction: Closing still with a slow push in on the open rate book. The ink of the new entry is still wet and catches the window light. The coins lie beside it and the pen rests in the inkstand. The handwriting cannot be read. Only the vestry ambience is heard: a door latch and footsteps on the stone floor.
